name: Daily ESP practice (McMoneagle exercises)
summary: Low-effort daily exercises from Joseph McMoneagle's Mind Trek (1993), in our own words: a sealed object, a sealed drawing, a word list before a visitor arrives, small predictions, and a log of spontaneous impressions. The run record timestamps your entries before you know the answers. Practice only: there is no blinding and the targets are self-chosen, so these results never count as evidence.
setting: Everyday life. A friend helps with the sealed object and the sealed drawing.
cautions: Not evidential: selective memory and loose matching make almost anything look like a hit. Keep these results apart from blinded trials and never pool them.

sources.title: McMoneagle J (1993) Mind Trek. Hampton Roads

steps.title: The rules
steps.instructions: McMoneagle's rules, in short: don't cheat; note exact times; discard nothing; write everything down; take it seriously; keep practising. Skip any exercise you can't do today.

steps.title: Sealed object
steps.instructions: A friend seals an object in a box without telling you what it is. Today, write one-word descriptors and the feeling each one evokes, aiming at the moment you will open the box. Repeat on 3 or 4 days, then open the box and underline what fits.

input.prompt: Descriptors and the feeling each evokes

steps.title: Sealed drawing
steps.instructions: A friend seals a simple drawing in an opaque envelope. Reproduce it here. Afterwards note the parts that are right even if they are not connected.

input.prompt: Your reproduction of the sealed drawing

steps.title: Word list
steps.instructions: Before a visitor arrives, write 10 or more unconnected words. Later, tick the ones that come up in the conversation.

steps.title: Small predictions
steps.instructions: Predict something small and checkable: a free parking space, an arrival time to the minute, a grocery total, the next rain. Write it now and score it later.

steps.title: Spontaneous impressions
steps.instructions: Log any out-of-the-blue impression with the exact time and date, so you can match it later.

input.prompt: Impressions with exact time and date

steps.title: Score earlier entries
steps.instructions: Score the entries from earlier days whose answers you now know. Count misses as honestly as hits.

items.label: Hits among earlier entries checked today
